difference: The preceding work assumed an inverse block. This derives an explicit attenuated approximate inverse from a different forward-block promise and proves that direct forward tomography already suffices for local inverse information. The known normalization M is treated as real information, not a free convention. This is not the new full-Fourier-label access model, and it does not revive r415 STRUCTURAL_MISMATCH or r468 RESTATEMENT, whose source defects and octave positivity targets are different.
